sloka: भिन्न मन्त्रो अपराद्धः च हीन शक्तिः कथम् हि अहम् ।किष्किन्धाम् प्राप्य जीवेयम् अनाथ इव दुर्बलः ॥४-५५-९॥
transliteration: bhinna mantro aparāddhaḥ ca hīna śaktiḥ katham hi aham ।kiṣkindhām prāpya jīveyam anātha iva durbalaḥ ॥4-55-9॥

translations.english: 'My alternate strategy has failed. I have already made a mistake (by announcing my plan). My advisors are holding different views. I am powerless. How can a weakling, an orphan like me live in Kishkinda?
